purpose: Expand Cousteau from one frozen field point into a global adversarial control and calibration corpus so every future candidate is compared against known natural, biological, geological, engineered, propagation and instrumentation mechanisms before interpretation.

new_high_value_cases.fact: Dense layers of fish, squid, jellyfish and other organisms can produce a sonar reflector that historically appeared as a moving second seafloor; swim bladders can dominate the return.
new_high_value_cases.why_cousteau_needs_it: Mandatory control against coherent seafloor-like or moving-layer target hallucination.
new_high_value_cases.source: NOAA Ocean Exploration deep scattering layer

new_high_value_cases.fact: Gas seeps form near-vertical high-reflectivity columns in multibeam water-column imagery; NOAA has labeled hundreds of thousands of water-column images for seep detection.
new_high_value_cases.why_cousteau_needs_it: Controls vertical geometric targets, bright water-column returns and apparent fixed seafloor sources.
new_high_value_cases.source: NOAA Ocean Exploration seep auto-detection and NCEI water-column archive

new_high_value_cases.fact: High-resolution marine seismic data can show acoustic chimneys, diffractions, abrupt reflectivity changes and wipeout zones associated with gas and gas hydrate.
new_high_value_cases.why_cousteau_needs_it: A buried or vertical-looking acoustic structure is not automatically an engineered body.
new_high_value_cases.source: USGS Gulf of Mexico gas-hydrate seismic studies

new_high_value_cases.fact: Grounding and fracturing ice can create steady tones, harmonic combs, frequency sweeps and enormous long-range broadband events detected thousands of kilometers away.
new_high_value_cases.why_cousteau_needs_it: Controls apparently mechanical, harmonic, moving and long-range acoustic anomalies.

new_high_value_cases.fact: Submarine/volcanogenic activity can produce harmonic tremor packets and undulating narrow-band signals detectable over ocean-basin scales.
new_high_value_cases.why_cousteau_needs_it: Controls resonant-looking low-frequency signatures not caused by structures.

new_high_value_cases.fact: A deliberate oceanographic sound beacon recorded by NOAA ramps to about 270 Hz and lasts about three minutes.
new_high_value_cases.why_cousteau_needs_it: A clean engineered tone/ramp in the sea can be an illuminator or beacon rather than a target return.

new_high_value_cases.fact: A small vessel passing close to a hydrophone can overwhelm other sounds and saturate the recording.
new_high_value_cases.why_cousteau_needs_it: Clipping and saturation can fabricate harmonics, broadened lines and distorted decay envelopes.

new_high_value_cases.fact: A published MARS hydrophone analysis documents a 50 kHz tone attributed to the cabled observatory power supply.
new_high_value_cases.why_cousteau_needs_it: Fixed spectral lines can come from the observing system itself; sensor/site self-noise must be modeled before target inference.

new_high_value_cases.fact: Low-frequency sonar can interact with the seabed, refract within it, return to the water column and form variable surface/bottom ducts depending on depth, bottom composition, topography and weather.
new_high_value_cases.why_cousteau_needs_it: A delayed or spatially displaced return may be propagation geometry rather than target motion or resonance.

new_high_value_cases.fact: NOAA Okeanos mapping operations explicitly calibrate multiple sonars and use K-Sync to reduce interference between systems.
new_high_value_cases.why_cousteau_needs_it: Cross-system interference must be treated as a first-class false-positive source in multi-sonar datasets.

global_open_data_backbone.cousteau_role: Global exact-line discovery and geological control mining
Raw active-sonar geometry, backscatter and water-column target corpus
Global passive-acoustic false-positive and ambient-sound corpus
Calibrated long-term low-frequency reference set across diverse ocean regions
Global swath-footprint and known-geometry bathymetric control discovery
High-volume raw hydrophone and calibrated spectral control library

global_admission_contract.P0_RAW_CONTROL: Raw or near-raw acoustic data plus traceable source/geometry/calibration. Highest value.
global_admission_contract.P1_RESOLVED_MIMIC: Phenomenon with a resolved natural/biological/instrumental cause and measurable acoustic signature.
global_admission_contract.P2_ENGINEERED_TARGET: Known submerged object or deliberate sound source with independent ground truth.
global_admission_contract.P3_UNRESOLVED_TRACEABLE: Unresolved signal with traceable primary recording and metadata. Watchlist only, never positive evidence.
global_admission_contract.P4_SECONDARY_STORY: Testimony/memoir/news without raw trace. Archive target only.
global_admission_contract.reject_rule: No case is promoted merely because it overlaps 119 Hz or 520 Hz. Frequency coincidence is non-specific.
